messages:
Nora Blake: late-night q: which paperback do you read when you want post-punk energy? think jagged sentences + restless heroes.
Ezra Wong: hmm, Grave New World vibes = "Less Than Zero" for me. short, clipped, noisy in prose.
Maya Ortiz: I get Joy Division out of "On the Road" actually. chaotic drive, yes.
Tom (mixtape-bot): dropped a quick playlist: https://open.spotify.com/playlist/37x-example (post-punk paperbacks)
Liam: recommend pairing: The Bell Jar + PiL early era. moody, angular.
Nora Blake: quick poll: do you read to music or in silence? react with :musical_note: for music, :mute: for silence.
Ezra Wong: music for me. gives rhythm to the sentences.
Maya Ortiz: silence usually but open to trying a playlist. @Tom can you export a 20-track mixtape from picks?
Tom (mixtape-bot): ```
mixtape_export_id: mixtape_198765
tracks: 20
created_by: Tom (mixtape-bot)
```
Liam: thanks! adding this to my commute. anyone else have a weird combo that actually works?
Nora Blake: @Liam try "A Visit from the Goon Squad" + The Cure early singles. fast, fragmented, satisfying.
Ezra Wong: bookmarking these. low-key we should do a "read-with-soundtrack" night. a few people + one hour and discuss vibes.
Maya Ortiz: in. call it "paperbacks & post-punk" :sparkles:
Tom (mixtape-bot): poll update: music 9, silence 4 (13 votes).
Nora Blake: cool. thanks all — sleep well and dream in basslines. :crescent_moon:
